title: Projecting development of TB-IRIS using RNA velocity of whole blood
description: TB-associated immune reconstitution inflammatory syndrome (TB-IRIS) is characterised by severe inflammation and immunopathology directed to TB pathogen shortly after commencing antiretroviral therapy (ART) in HIV-TB coinfected patients. This study aims to investigate if RNA Velocity strategy can be used to predict development of TB-IRIS
